summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for pie/donut chart angle computation using d3.pie(). It differs semantically from peer candidates (Stack Generator, Arc Generator, Bin Generator) which handle stacking layouts, arc shape rendering, and data discretization respectively. It also differs from existing skills (Collection-based Data Source, Iterative Stream Loop) which operate in different domains (Java streaming, not D3 visualization). The candidate has clear support evidence and no conflicts. No existing skill in the registry covers pie angle generation.
